newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - Croatia weekly - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Croatia weekly - July 2.

text.p: Following are the main stories from Croatian weekly news magazine Globus. Reuters has not verified the stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Who will be the new Zagreb archbishop: Zelimir Puljic, Stjepan Kusar, Josip Bozanic or Marko Culej?
- A well known Belgrade attorney is accusing General Klein of tricking his client Dokmanovic into getting arrested.
- Small private banks were successful in gaining fresh assets.
- The Merrill Lynch investment fund seems to be the largest buyer of Pliva shares.
- A 24-year-old suspected dealer of hot cars is shot dead in the centre of Zagreb.
- Interview with Foreign Minister Mate Granic: Croatia is fully backing the survival of Bosnia and Herzegovina as envisaged in the Dayton agreement.

- The Defence Ministry is refusing to pay back 100 million marks that have been paid by citizens who bought military flats and have paid too much for them according to a constitutional court decision. -- Zagreb newsroom, +385 1 455 7075
